title: Flexible, knowledgable and personable guide
text: Bea is a great guide! We had two guided tours with her while we were in Seville - one of the Alcazar and one of the cathedral. She was thoughtful and helpful about my dad’s mobility impairment (he uses a mobility scooter) and was very open and responsive to all my mum’s questions! When we said we wanted to specifically know more about the architecture she got up early that day to do extra research and tailor the tour with lots of fascinating details. title: Wonderful experience
text: The visit to Cathedral and Alcazar was wonderful. Beatriz is an excellent professional, very trained, entertaining and very attentive, we were 12 people, and she was watching everyone so that we had the best time possible. Congratulations Bea, thank you so much for everything.
